end.summary:
Practised defining physical change and giving examples; easy questions were answered right, with a why or new-situation question still to check.
Practised defining chemical change and recognising gas, colour change, heat/light, new smell and new solid; a why or new-situation question is still to check.
Practised classifying changes using evidence; reversibility was used as a clue, but classification was not steady yet.
Practised telling melting apart from dissolving; dissolved sugar was still treated as having disappeared and losing mass, so this needs revisiting.
end.parentNote: Asha practised physical and chemical changes through examples such as paper cutting, rusting, sparklers, melting wax and burning a wick. Ananya used useful evidence such as “no new substance,” colour change, gas, heat and light; the method of checking whether a new substance forms should be practised with fresh examples. The mix-up that dissolved sugar disappears and loses mass was still present at the end, so at home, dissolve a spoon of sugar in water and discuss how it is still present even when it cannot be seen.

Aapko lag raha hai ki cheeni dikhni band hui, toh hawa mein udd gayi. Sochiye, dhakkan band glass mein cheeni daalne ke baad kuch bahar nahi nikla; cheeni ab paani mein ghuli hui hai, gayab nahi hui. Dhakkan khole bina glass ko tolein, toh wazan pehle se badhega, utna rahega ya ghatega?
ummm... ghatega shayad? kyunki cheeni gayab ho gayi na... jaise doodh se dahi banti hai toh wapas doodh nahi banti, waise hi cheeni bhi gayab ho gayi toh wazan kam ho jayega

Aapko lag raha hai cheeni gayab hui, jaise doodh dahi bana. Par dahi mein naya padarth banta hai; cheeni ghulne par meetha swaad ab bhi batata hai ki woh paani mein hai, aur uska wazan bhi rehta hai. Ab garam kiye bina paani mein cheeni milayein aur chocolate ko garam karke liquid banayein: kis mein ghulna hua, aur kis mein pighalna?
mujhe samajh nahi aa raha... sugar gayi kahan, aur chocolate pighalna... pata nahi, dono mix ho rahe hain na?

Haan, aapko lag raha hai dono mix ho rahe hain. Chocolate garam hokar apne aap liquid banti hai; usmein paani nahi milaya. Cheeni ke case mein pehle chhota step lete hain: meetha paani chakhne par cheeni ka pata chalta hai ya nahi?
